notes.title: Our new game is on Greenlight!
notes.notes:
Our game, Marble Machine needs yours votes!!! :)

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=865263003

This game was made for mobile phones initially, but we were improving it in recent months and we think it's now mature enough to invade Steam : )

The game will be cheaper than Grandpa's Table, but it will offer more than 120 relaxing logic puzzles. Puzzles will be easier than those in late chapters of Grandpa's Table, but we think they will give a lot of satisfaction to anyone who will give them a shot : ) 

We are counting on your vote :)

[img] https://media.giphy.com/media/l0He1GbcN0Ti8mM3S/giphy.gif [/img]

notes.title: Grandpa's Table on MacOS !!!
notes.notes:
New update for Grandpa's Table is available!
During recent days we were working on bringing Grandpa's Table to MacOS users. From now on our game is available for those users as well - we hope you will have a wonderful time with our game :)
Also in this update, there is small fix for 'Good old friends' achievement which was not working, thanks goes to 'Look' for reporting this bug :)
ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: New update for Grandpa's Table is here!
notes.notes:
In this update we have added classical music track "Gymnopédie no.1" written by  Erick Satie and performed by Myuu... as well as two original Myuu compositions.
If you like this music you definitely should check Myuu site: http://www.thedarkpiano.com
Also if you like Grandpa's Table music in general you should as well check  http://www.zero-project.gr/ since other music pieces comes from this composer :)

Additionally in this version there is also ability to go back to level choose screen directly after completing the puzzle.
And a lot nicer texture on volume slider.

Have a great weekend everyone :)

notes.notes:
* New "volume-change" slider on the radio.

notes.title: First update is live now!
notes.notes:
*In window mode it's possible to change window size freely.
*Fixed duplicated resolutions in options screen.
*Smaller default zoom during the game play (it's possible to change zoom with mouse wheel)
*Our social sites rendering bug, is fixed (envelope in main menu).

Thank you for all the feedback! ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hello everybody!
notes.notes:
As you already know Grandpa's Table is live on Steam now. It's our first Steam game and we are little nervous :)
If you will have any problems - please let us know with email or post on discussion page of the game. We hope you will have fun and relaxing time with our game :)

Jakub&Isabell
